title: 1991 Fleer Ultra Greg Maddux #64 Chicago Cubs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1991 Fleer Ultra sports trading card features Greg Maddux, a well-known baseball player who played for the Chicago Cubs. The card is part of the 1991 set and has the card number 64. It was manufactured by Fleer in 1991 and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The card is in excellent shape and is perfect for collectors who want to add a piece of sports history to their collection.
